title: Entry into Israel Law, 5712-1952
source_id: ס"ח תשי"ב, 354 (Sefer HaChukim 5712, p 354); Knesset IsraelLawID 2000324; Wikisource page 'חוק הכניסה לישראל'
verified_how: Knesset Open Data KNS_IsraelLaw record fetched 23 September 2026: IsraelLawID 2000324, Name 'חוק הכניסה לישראל, התשי"ב-1952', KnessetNum 2, PublicationDate 1952-09-05, ValidityStartDate 1952-09-05, LatestPublicationDate 2026-07-20, LawValidityDesc 'תקף', ValidityFinishDate null, LastUpdatedDate 2025-09-15. KNS_LawBinding returned 65 rows: 1 'החוק המקורי' with PageNumber '354' and 64 'מתקן' rows. KNS_IsraelLawName returned a single name, so the Act has never been renamed. The same name search also returned two DIFFERENT Acts that must not be confused with it: 'חוק האזרחות והכניסה לישראל (הוראת שעה), התשס"ג-2003' (IsraelLawID 2000171, LawValidityDesc 'פקע' - expired, ValidityFinishDate 2021-07-06) and 'חוק האזרחות והכניסה לישראל (הוראת שעה), התשפ"ב-2022' (IsraelLawID 2191134, ValidityFinishDate 2024-03-14 with LawValidityDesc still recorded as 'תקף' and a stale LastUpdatedDate of 2023-03-16). Neither is the general entry/visa statute and neither is indexed here. The Hebrew Wikisource page prints 'חוק הכניסה לישראל, תשי"ב–1952', citation 'ס"ח תשי"ב, 354', amendments through תשפ"ו (2026), a reference to the annual-quota order 'צו הכניסה לישראל (מכסה שנתית...)' for 2024, and notes that some provisions carry sunset dates (one to 24 April 2027) while the statute itself is not repealed. Official page 354 matches Wikisource, and LatestPublicationDate 2026-07-20 matches the תשפ"ו amendments.
notes: The general visa and residence-permit statute, and the instrument under which a work visa (B/1) is actually issued: categories of visa and permit, powers of the Minister of the Interior and border-control officers, conditions, extension, revocation, removal and custody. THREE cautions. (1) Much of the operative detail is in subordinate legislation - the Entry into Israel Regulations, 5734-1974 and annual quota orders (צווי מכסה שנתית) - so the Act alone does not state the visa classes' conditions in full. (2) Some provisions are subject to sunset clauses (Wikisource flags one running to 24 April 2027); an encoding must carry them. (3) Do NOT confuse this Act with the Citizenship and Entry into Israel (Temporary Provision) Laws of 2003 and 2022, which are separate, narrower and time-limited instruments - see verified_how for their official status.

text_caveat: Unofficial consolidation. Israel publishes no free official consolidated text; the official version is the original publication in Reshumot plus every amending Act. The text is the law as maintained at retrieval (revision 3037272), not a historical vintage.
